design.covariance_recipe: covariance_cases(setup()); source bytes recorded below; no sampling or fitted rescaling

scope: Synthetic local response diagnostics, fixed S2a weights. No calibrated test under added errors, full nonlinear envelope, general jerk bound or population coverage.

nominal_fit.scope: Vacuum synthetic model; local covariance conditional on declared correlated noise and independent clock calibration. No global or systematic-error bound.

s2a_known_holdout.scope: Local Gaussian transport and separate affine systematic box only. Fixed S2a weights; its residual p is not recalibrated for extra errors. No total nonlinear 95% bound or RF qualification.
